name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware
benefit:
1. The scheme provides a production-linked incentive to eligible companies.
1. An incentive is provided on net incremental sales (over the base year) of goods manufactured in India.
1. The incentive rate is:

  - 4% to 2% / 1% on incremental sales.

1. The incentive is applicable for a period of 4 years.
1. The incentive is applicable only for goods covered under the target segment, which includes
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a company registered in India and engaged in manufacturing eligible IT hardware products. 1. The applicant should meet the minimum investment thresholds specified under the scheme. 1. The applicant should meet the incremental production or sales targets under the scheme. 1. The applicant should comply with all conditions prescribed in the scheme guidelines. 1. The applicant should be classified under the Global Companies or Domestic Companies category. 1. The applicant should meet category-specific investment and production thresholds.
